concept: OrchardOps: harvest tracking for a fruit orchard. Trees are recorded per plot; staff log harvests per tree and move each tree through growing -> ripe -> picked stages.

entities.name: Tree
Harvest

invariants.statement: canMoveStage is true exactly for the valid next stages growing -> ripe and ripe -> picked. Every other transition is invalid, including staying in the same stage.

clauses: Export GET. Read variety from searchParams.
Build where object with variety contains when variety is set.
Call db.tree.findMany with where ordered by variety asc, include harvests relation.
Return NextResponse.json with trees and total.
Export POST. Await req.json.
Validate kg with Number; when not between 1 and 2000 return 400 'Kg must be 1-2000'.
Call db.tree.findUnique where id body.treeId; when missing return 404 'Tree not found'.
Call db.harvest.create with data kg, pickedAt, treeId.
Return NextResponse.json with harvest and status 201.

concept: HarborDesk: berth booking for a boat marina. Berths are recorded per dock; most bookings reserve a berth, but transient bookings without a berth are allowed.

entities.name: Berth
Booking

invariants.statement: bookingsOverlap is true exactly when two booking windows [aStart, aEnd] and [bStart, bEnd] overlap at any point (touching endpoints counts as overlap).
invariants.signature: bookingsOverlap(aStart: string, aEnd: string, bStart: string, bEnd: string)

clauses: Export GET. Read vessel from searchParams.
Build where object with vessel contains when vessel is set.
Call db.booking.findMany with where ordered by start asc, include berth relation.
Return NextResponse.json with bookings and total.
Export POST. Await req.json.
Trim vessel with String; when empty return 400 'Vessel is required'.
When body.berthId is provided call db.berth.findUnique where id body.berthId; when missing return 404 'Berth not found'.
Call db.booking.create with data vessel, start, end and berthId only when provided.
Return NextResponse.json with booking and status 201.

concept: KneadOps: wholesale bakery batch tracking. Ovens are recorded with a maximum load; batches start in the proofing stage and must fit the oven's capacity.

entities.name: Oven
Batch

invariants.statement: isProofTempOk is true exactly when celsius is at least 18 and at most 26 (both inclusive).

clauses: Export GET. Read status from searchParams.
Build where object with status equals when status is set.
Call db.batch.findMany with where ordered by dough asc, include oven relation.
Return NextResponse.json with batches and total.
Export POST. Await req.json.
Validate loadKg with Number; when not at least 1 return 400 'Load must be positive'.
Call db.oven.findUnique where id body.ovenId; when missing return 404 'Oven not found'.
Call db.batch.create with data dough, loadKg, ovenId and status defaulting to proofing.
Return NextResponse.json with batch and status 201.
